identificationModule.briefTitle: DS-8201a in Pre-treated HER2 Breast Cancer That Cannot be Surgically Removed or Has Spread [DESTINY-Breast02]
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label, Active-controlled Study of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (DS-8201a), an Anti-HER2-antibody Drug Conjugate, Versus Treatment of Investigator's Choice for HER2-positive, Unresectable and/or Metastatic Breast Cancer Subjects Previously Treated With T-DM1

armGroups.label: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (DS-8201a)
armGroups.description: HER2 positive, unresectable and/or metastatic breast cancer participants previously treated with standard of care HER2 therapies, including ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1), randomized to treatment with DS-8201a

armGroups.label: Trastuzumab+capecitabine
armGroups.description: HER2 positive, unresectable and/or metastatic breast cancer participants previously treated with standard of care HER2 therapies, including ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1), randomized to investigator's choice treatment with Trastuzumab/capecitabine

armGroups.label: Lapatinib+capecitabine
armGroups.description: HER2 positive, unresectable and/or metastatic breast cancer participants previously treated with standard of care HER2 therapies, including ado-trastuzumab emtansine (T-DM1), randomized to investigator's choice treatment with Lapatinib/capecitabine

interventions.name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
interventions.description: DS-8201a is sterile lyophilized powder reconstituted into a sterile aqueous solution (100 mg/5 mL) to be administered as intravenous (IV) dose

interventions.name: Capecitabine
interventions.description: Investigator's choice Standard of Care when combined with trastuzumab or lapatinib

interventions.name: Lapatinib
interventions.description: Investigator's choice Standard of Care when combined with capecitabine

interventions.name: Trastuzumab
interventions.description: Investigator's choice Standard of Care when combined with capecitabine
